name: Chilli Design System
notes: This repository is currently a private Next.js documentation app, not a published package.
Use index.ts as the local public entry point until a package name and exports map are configured.

components.name: AccordionGroup
components.description: Controls a group of accordion items in single or multiple expand mode.
useWhen: Group related collapsible sections.
doNotUseWhen: Content must always remain visible.

components.name: AccordionItem
components.description: Displays one collapsible content section with an animated chevron.
useWhen: Hide secondary information until the user asks for it.
doNotUseWhen: The content is required for the main task.

components.name: ActionCtaCard
components.description: Displays a campaign action card across action types and completion states.
useWhen: Show a concrete action inside a campaign flow.
doNotUseWhen: A smaller generic CTA tile is enough.

components.name: ActionInput
components.description: Glass-style input for action forms with label, icons, avatar, toggle, helper and error states.
useWhen: Collect short action-specific text in a high-emphasis form.
doNotUseWhen: A standard form field should use Input.

components.name: ActionNavigation
components.description: Top navigation for action screens with close, title, optional icon buttons and action button.
useWhen: Build a focused action screen header.
doNotUseWhen: The surface is a normal page; use PageNavigation.

components.name: ActionTextArea
components.description: Textarea with a prompt question for action-oriented forms.
useWhen: Ask the supporter to write longer action content.
doNotUseWhen: The field is a generic multiline form field; use TextArea.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Displays a profile image with fallback initials or placeholder.
useWhen: Represent a creator, supporter or account.
doNotUseWhen: Multiple people should be shown together; use AvatarGroup or AvatarDuo.

components.name: AvatarDuo
components.description: Displays two overlapping avatars.
useWhen: Show a pair of related people or accounts.
doNotUseWhen: Show more than two people; use AvatarGroup.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: Displays overlapping avatars with optional remaining count and add action.
useWhen: Show social proof or a group of supporters.
doNotUseWhen: Only one identity is present; use Avatar.

components.name: AvatarLabel
components.description: Combines an avatar with a name and supporting text.
useWhen: Show identity plus short metadata.
doNotUseWhen: Only the image is needed; use Avatar.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small label for status, counts or categories.
useWhen: Annotate a surface with compact metadata.
doNotUseWhen: The item is interactive; use Chip or Button.

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary command component with variants, sizes, icons, loading and glass styling.
useWhen: Trigger a clear user action.
doNotUseWhen: Only an icon is visible; use IconButton.

components.name: CampaignCard
components.description: Mobile feed card for a campaign with full-bleed media, title, supporter proof and action states.
useWhen: Display a campaign in feeds, lists or related campaign carousels.
doNotUseWhen: Rendering the full campaign detail page; use CampaignPage.

components.name: CampaignPage
components.description: Composed campaign detail surface with hero, creator information and actions.
useWhen: Prototype or render a campaign detail composition.
doNotUseWhen: Only a feed preview is needed; use CampaignCard.

components.name: CauseChip
components.description: Colored chip for cause labels using the predefined cause color set.
useWhen: Label a cause or issue category.
doNotUseWhen: The chip is not cause-related; use Chip.

components.name: CauseInput
components.description: Input specialized for selecting or entering a cause.
useWhen: Collect a cause value in action setup.
doNotUseWhen: The value is generic text; use Input.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Control for selecting one or more options.
useWhen: Allow multiple selections or confirmations.
doNotUseWhen: Only one option can be selected; use Radio.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Compact tag, filter or selection with optional avatar, social icon or remove action.
useWhen: Show a compact selected item, filter or tag.
doNotUseWhen: Show non-interactive metadata; use Badge.

components.name: CtaCard
components.description: Dark CTA card with a channel chip, clamped title, optional preview text, optional media, social proof and either text CTAs or a round arrow CTA.
useWhen: Show one clear email, social, maps, link, question, call or petition action with compact context and proof inside a campaign or action list.
doNotUseWhen: The action needs pinned, completed or top-supporter states; use ActionCtaCard.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Calendar component for choosing dates.
useWhen: The user needs to choose a calendar date.
doNotUseWhen: The design requires a compact date range pill; use SelectDatePicker.

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: Floating menu container for actions or options.
useWhen: Show a small list of actions or choices in an overlay.
doNotUseWhen: The user is selecting a value from a field; use Select.

components.name: MenuItem
components.description: Selectable row used inside Dropdown.
useWhen: Build custom dropdown menu content.
doNotUseWhen: The menu is generated by Select.

components.name: FormTitle
components.description: Pill-shaped title input for action forms.
useWhen: Collect the title of an action or form section.
doNotUseWhen: The field is regular text input; use Input.

components.name: HeaderApp
components.description: Mobile app-level header for home, notification, search and profile screens.
useWhen: Build a 375px mobile app header.
doNotUseWhen: Build a generic page header; use PageNavigation.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Round icon-only button for compact actions.
useWhen: The action is represented by an icon only.
doNotUseWhen: The action needs visible text; use Button.

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text input with label, helper text, icons, clear button and error state.
useWhen: Collect a single-line text value.
doNotUseWhen: The form belongs to an action-specific glass surface; use ActionInput.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description: Verification code input with individual digit cells.
useWhen: Collect short numeric verification codes.
doNotUseWhen: Collect arbitrary numeric values; use Input with numeric type.

components.name: PageNavigation
components.description: Top navigation bar for pages with back button, title and action icons.
useWhen: Build a normal page header.
doNotUseWhen: Build a focused action flow header; use ActionNavigation.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Segmented progress indicator with optional label.
useWhen: Show completion progress across steps or campaign actions.
doNotUseWhen: The user must choose a value; this is not an input slider.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Single-choice option control.
useWhen: The user must choose one option from a set.
doNotUseWhen: Multiple choices are allowed; use Checkbox.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Context provider for grouped radio options.
useWhen: Group radio controls that share one value.
doNotUseWhen: Options can be selected independently; use Checkbox.

components.name: SearchBar
components.description: Search input with leading search icon and clear affordance.
useWhen: Filter or search a list of content.
doNotUseWhen: Collect generic text; use Input.

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown select trigger with menu options.
useWhen: Choose one option from a predefined list.
doNotUseWhen: Choose a date range; use SelectDatePicker.

components.name: SelectDatePicker
components.description: Date range input with compact start and end date pills.
useWhen: Collect a start and end date range.
doNotUseWhen: Choose one calendar date; use DatePicker.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabbed navigation for switching between related panels.
useWhen: Switch between peer sections in the same context.
doNotUseWhen: Navigate between pages; use a navigation component.

components.name: TextArea
components.description: Multiline text input with label, helper text, error state and optional AI action.
useWhen: Collect longer free-form text.
doNotUseWhen: The prompt is action-specific; use ActionTextArea.

components.name: ThinkingIndicator
components.description: Animated loading indicator for thinking or AI response states.
useWhen: Show an assistant or process is thinking.
doNotUseWhen: Show linear progress; use ProgressBar.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Binary switch with animated thumb and optional label.
useWhen: Enable or disable one setting immediately.
doNotUseWhen: The choice is part of a submitted form with many options; consider Checkbox.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Contextual helper popup shown on hover or focus.
useWhen: Explain an icon-only control or compact UI label.
doNotUseWhen: The information is required to complete the task; show it inline.
